$comment: Street furniture (tools/content/kit/street.mjs; Tileset 11, Urban & Civilian: docs/map-briefs/urban/URBAN_PLAN.md step C): a bike rack, a street mailbox, a newspaper box and a bus stop sign, generated in code. They replace nothing. No real marks: the mailbox and the newspaper box are plain paint, with no service's or publisher's name, sign or livery; the bus stop sign is a plain picture of a bus, with no words, no route number and no operator's mark. The bollard is kit.barrier.bollard, the cable spool kit.spool.cable, the awning kit.shop.awning.

notes.1: First version (Tileset 11, Urban & Civilian): three steel hoops 0.85 m high and 0.7 m long, 0.95 m apart on two flat ground rails (2 × 0.85 × 0.7 m). Looks: galvanised, black, green and red. It collides as its hoops only (two legs and a top bar each, 5 cm tube): shots and sight pass between them, as through the Rail Fence; the ground rails are drawn only.

First version: a street mailbox 0.56 m wide, 1.22 m high and 0.5 m deep: a steel box with a rounded top on four short legs, a pull-down door, a collection door and a blank plate. Plain paint: no postal service's name, sign or livery. Looks: blue, red, green and yellow. Collides as its box: crouch cover.

First version: a newspaper box 0.5 m wide, 1.2 m high and 0.46 m deep: a steel cabinet on a post and a base plate, a window door with a blank sheet behind the glass, a pull handle, a coin box. Plain paint: no publisher's name or sign, nothing printed. Looks: red, blue, yellow, green and white. Collides as its box: crouch cover.

First version (Tileset 11 follow-up: the bus shelter had only a street-name sign): a 6 cm pole 2.7 m high on a base plate, a flag sign 0.5 m square at its top reaching to one side with a plain picture of a bus on both faces, and a timetable case with a blank sheet. No words, no route number, no operator's mark or livery. Looks: blue, yellow and green plates, and red. It collides as its pole and its flag only (2.14 m of clear height under the flag): a player walks under the flag, shots pass beside the pole.
